blocks.note: What runs at the edge is chosen by physics, not fashion: latency, bandwidth and autonomy constraints decide placement — and the fleet is managed as one estate.

blocks.x: The reference pattern behind Microsoft Azure Alliance is boring on purpose: contracts at every boundary, an owner per component, and evidence captured where the work happens. Boring architecture is what survives contact with an audit.
